problem:

Question 2
?

Given that the differential equation

t2y″+2ty′=12t3−24t2,t>0

has the complimentary function yc(t)=A+Bt, find the particular solution yp(t) to this equation.

a
yp(t)=4t3+6t2
b
yp(t)=−6t3−t2
c
yp(t)=t3−4t2
d
yp(t)=−t3+5t
e
yp(t)=2t3−3t
